android.desc:
You be a streamer and share scenes with people who join in your streaming in real-time. There is a "Content Description" section you can edit introduction of your streaming which can be easily searched in the forefront of this app  at the "Let People Find You" section.

How can people find your streaming? 1. Through google map, 2. Through both contents or number of viewers search, 3. You can have streaming ID from your peers directly.   

You can chat during your streaming with viewers and check viewers statistics such as number of people joined.

If one of viewers would like Video Chat, it is automatically shared with remaining viewers after your acceptance.

You need to give permissions to this app such as Location, Camera, and Microphone. Please make sure that your video and audio muted if you are viewers except of your intention for Video-Chat. Recommend to use sposync.com web app instant broadcast mode on browsers for the use under most networks because this Android app works under WIFI only.

You can start streaming by push "Start Here", choose your camera and push "Choose Media", then ready to go.

If viewers access your streaming, the "Disconnect" button is activated and
also you can check "Joiners Stat" at the bottom table.

Viewers can connect to streaming by push "Try Connect" and wait for
live streaming shows up. It may take two or three trial under different networks and bandwidth conditions.

Streamers and viewers must push "Disconnect" button after activities are finished not to use data anymore. 
 
You can experience full-fledged app features, through the web app https://sposync.com on your mobile or desktop browsers. Especially Instant Broadcast Mode is exact replica of this app but works not only under WIFI but also most networks. In other words, you can share your moment seamlessly around globe. Please check the demo at the website.
